task: Decide whether the nested morphology-potency proposal improves terminal conservative potency over the promoted applicability proposal at matched generation and oracle budgets

scientific_lane.individual_component_identity_policy: amine, aldehyde and isocyanide identities must each occur in the measured AGILE fit population
scientific_lane.combination_policy: the exact three-component combination must be absent from the measured AGILE population
scientific_lane.validated_generalization_regime: held aldehyde-isocyanide pairing with individual aldehyde and isocyanide identities observed elsewhere in fit data
scientific_lane.exact_new_component_policy: biological abstention; retain only in the unguided exploration lane
scientific_lane.potency_utility: positive half of the held-pair LCB90 calibration ECDF

budgets.oracle_budget_rule: classify every valid exact-L1 terminal without oracle calls, then score a deterministic hash-ordered subset of eligible terminals of size equal to the smallest eligible-arm count

decision_rule.promote: all gates pass and the nested potency arm beats the promoted applicability arm at matched budgets
decision_rule.reject: otherwise retain promoted applicability generation plus terminal conservative ranking
